name: Return to Onu
label: Quest
description: You carry a page from the Twilight Tome back to Onu in Darkshore. The scribbles are all you could bear to take from the cultists’ book.

clips.title: The story
paras: You carry a page from the Twilight Tome back to Onu in Darkshore. The scribbles are all you could bear to take from the cultists’ book.

The Twilight Tome overwhelms anyone who tries to read it. Its words swim across the page, and its ornate scrollwork twists into grotesque figures. You tear out a single page of scribbles before the strain brings on vertigo.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening. Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.
Tearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles. I sense the work of the old ones in it.
Let us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore...
